name: Levuka Historical Port Town
description: Levuka is a small seaside town on the east coast of Ovalau island in Fiji, and it was the country's first colonial capital until 1877. Its low timber storefronts and old warehouses line the beach front among coconut and mango trees. Built by traders from America and Europe beside Fijian villages, it still feels like a 19th-century Pacific port.
